content.short: Arweave is a decentralized file storage protocol where stored data will perpetually exist on chain.
content.description: Arweave is a protocol that enables anyone to store data with censorship resistance and long-term durability. The permaweb operates on this protocol and hosts all network products. The Arweave ecosystem includes profit-sharing communities, Ardrive, and Verto. This setup supports collective ownership and open access to a growing suite of decentralized storage tools, empowering developers and communities to preserve data over time without fear of degradation or loss.
content.meta: Arweave is a decentralized file storage protocol where data is stored on chain. Discover Arweave and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
